content:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ENUM CONSTANTS (stored as String in SQLite, documented here)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Gender: "male" | "female" | "non-binary" | "transgender" | "other"
// BodyType: "slim" | "average" | "athletic" | "muscular" | "curvy" | "bbw" | "stocky"
// Ethnicity: "white" | "black" | "latino" | "asian" | "middle-eastern" | "indian" | "mixed" | "other"
// LookingFor: "relationship" | "casual" | "friends" | "networking" | "not-specified"
// RelationshipStatus: "single" | "in-a-relationship" | "married" | "divorced" | "widowed" | "open-relationship"
// Position: "top" | "bottom" | "versatile" | "side" | "not-specified"
// ChatType: "direct" | "group"
// MessageType: "text" | "image" | "video" | "audio" | "gift" | "system" | "sticker"
// SubscriptionTier: "free" | "premium" | "vip" | "creator"
// BoostType: "standard" | "super" | "spotlight" | "mega"
// GroupRole: "owner" | "admin" | "moderator" | "member"
// RSVPStatus: "going" | "maybe" | "interested" | "declined"
// VerificationStatus: "none" | "pending" | "verified" | "rejected"
// ProfessionalStatus: "none" | "pending" | "approved" | "suspended"
// ShoutType: "text" | "image" | "video"
// NoteType: "private" | "public"
// EventType: "social" | "party" | "meetup" | "sports" | "cultural" | "live" | "exclusive" | "sale" | "upcoming"
// ChatSortMode: "recent" | "intent" | "quality" | "unread" | "online"

model User {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  username      String    @unique
  displayName   String
  email         String    @unique
  passwordHash  String
  avatar        String?
  bio           String?
  age           Int?
  gender        String    @default("male")
  location      String?
  lat           Float?
  lng           Float?
  geoCity       String?
  geoRegion     String?
  geoCountry    String?
  geoAccuracy   Float?
  online        Boolean   @default(true)
  lastSeen      DateTime  @default(now())
  isPremium     Boolean   @default(false)
  premiumExpiry DateTime?
  isVerified    Boolean   @default(false)
  isBanned      Boolean   @default(false)
  showOnline    Boolean   @default(true)
  showDistance   Boolean   @default(true)
  showAge       Boolean   @default(true)
  showActivity  Boolean   @default(true)
  hidePicsOffline Boolean @default(false)
  lookingFor    String    @default("relationship")
  aboutMe       String?
  height        Int?
  weight        Int?
  ethnicity     String?
  bodyType      String?
  relationshipStatus String?
  position      String?
  hivStatus     String?
  pronouns      String?
  displayUnits  String    @default("metric")
  lang          String    @default("en")
  soundOff      Boolean   @default(false)
  notifPushOff  Boolean   @default(false)
  notifEmailOff Boolean   @default(false)
  notifTelegramOff Boolean @default(false)
  mailingInternal Boolean @default(true)
  mailingPartner  Boolean @default(true)
  profileOff    Boolean   @default(false)
  privateAuto   Boolean   @default(false)
  noPros        Boolean   @default(false)
  noPub         Boolean   @default(false)
  isProfessional Boolean  @default(false)
  professionalStatus String @default("none")
  verificationStatus String @default("none")
  voucher       String?
  // AI / chat quality
  detectedIntent String?
  chatQualityScore Float?
  // Travel Mode (from ROMEO)
  isTraveling    Boolean   @default(false)
  travelCity     String?
  travelCountry  String?
  travelLat      Float?
  travelLng      Float?
  travelStart    DateTime?
  travelEnd      DateTime?
  // DND Schedule (from Grindr/OMOLINK)
  dndEnabled     Boolean   @default(false)
  dndStart       String?
  dndEnd         String?
  // Profile Hashtags (from Grindr)
  hashtags       String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  sentMessages     Message[]     @relation("SentMessages")
  receivedMessages Message[]     @relation("ReceivedMessages")
  sentLikes        Like[]        @relation("SentLikes")
  receivedLikes    Like[]        @relation("ReceivedLikes")
  sentBlocks       Block[]       @relation("SentBlocks")
  receivedBlocks   Block[]       @relation("ReceivedBlocks")
  sentViews        ProfileView[] @relation("SentViews")
  receivedViews    ProfileView[] @relation("ReceivedViews")
  photos           Photo[]
  albums           Album[]
  fansite          Fansite?
  subscriptions    Subscription[]
  sentChatRequests ChatRequest[]  @relation("SentChatRequest")
  receivedChatRequests ChatRequest[]  @relation("ReceivedChatRequest")
  groupMemberships GroupMember[]
  ownedGroups      GroupChat[]
  events           Event[]
  eventRSVPs       EventRSVP[]
  footprints       Footprint[]   @relation("FootprintTarget")
  createdFootprints Footprint[]  @relation("FootprintCreator")
  boostHistory     Boost[]
  shouts           Shout[]
  notesWritten     UserNote[]    @relation("NoteWriter")
  notesReceived    UserNote[]    @relation("NoteTarget")
  favoritesAdded   UserFavorite[] @relation("FavBy")
  superFavoritesAdded UserFavorite[] @relation("SuperFavBy")
  blogs            Blog[]
  videos           Video[]
  banners          Banner[]
  verifications    Verification[]
  sessions         UserSession[]
  profileFields    ProfileField[]
  // New feature relations
  circles          Circle[]
  circleMemberships CircleMember[]  @relation("CircleMembership")
  checkins         Checkin[]
  wallet           Wallet?
  savedPhrases     SavedPhrase[]
  conversationParticipants ConversationParticipant[]
  likedPhotos      LikedPhoto[]
  contactFolders   ContactFolder[]
}

model Message {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  content       String
  senderId      String
  receiverId    String
  chatType      String    @default("direct")
  groupId       String?
  isRead        Boolean   @default(false)
  isDeleted     Boolean   @default(false)
  type          String    @default("text")
  mediaUrl      String?
  // ── Chat Feature Fields ──
  replyToId     String?
  reactions     String?
  isPinned      Boolean   @default(false)
  isFavorited   Boolean   @default(false)
  expiresAt     DateTime?
  isRecalled    Boolean   @default(false)
  translation   String?
  translatedLang String?
  scheduledAt   DateTime?
  albumId       String?
  locationData  String?
  eventId       String?
  voiceDuration Int?
  pollData      String?
  callData      String?
  // AI summary
  aiSummary     String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  sender   User       @relation("SentMessages", fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  receiver User       @relation("ReceivedMessages", fields: [receiverId], references: [id])
  group    GroupChat? @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id])
  replyTo  Message?   @relation("MessageReply", fields: [replyToId], references: [id])
  replies  Message[]  @relation("MessageReply")
}

model Like {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  senderId  String
  receiverId String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  sender   User @relation("SentLikes", fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  receiver User @relation("ReceivedLikes", fields: [receiverId], references: [id])

  @@unique([senderId, receiverId])
}

model Block {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  blockerId String
  blockedId String
  reason    String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  blocker User @relation("SentBlocks", fields: [blockerId], references: [id])
  blocked User @relation("ReceivedBlocks", fields: [blockedId], references: [id])

  @@unique([blockerId, blockedId])
}

model ProfileView {
  id       String   @id @default(cuid())
  viewerId String
  viewedId String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  viewer User @relation("SentViews", fields: [viewerId], references: [id])
  viewed User @relation("ReceivedViews", fields: [viewedId], references: [id])
}

model Photo {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  url       String
  thumbnailUrl String?
  width     Int?
  height    Int?
  isPrivate Boolean  @default(false)
  isExpiring Boolean  @default(false)
  expiresAt DateTime?
  sortOrder Int      @default(0)
  albumId   String?
  userId    String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user  User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  album Album?  @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id])
}

model Album {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  isPrivate Boolean  @default(false)
  userId    String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user   User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  photos Photo[]
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PROFILE FIELDS — Flexible key-value for kinks/sexual/interest data
// Keys: tribes, fetishes, sm_level, ff_role, safer_sex, dick_size,
//   circumcision, hair_color, hair_length, eye_color, beard, piercings,
//   tattoos, going_out, music_genres, sports, food, travel_style,
//   profession, religion, meet_at, dirty_sex, body_mods
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
model ProfileField {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String
  key    String
  value  String
  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, key])
}

model Fansite {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  nick        String   @unique
  description  String?
  geoName     String?
  trailerUrl  String?
  trailerImageUrl String?
  status      String   @default("draft")
  isAnonymous Boolean  @default(false)
  statusComments String?
  userId      String   @unique
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  user    User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  links   FansiteLink[]
  products FansiteProduct[]
}

model FansiteLink {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  type      String
  url       String
  label     String?
  value     String?
  icon      String?
  fansiteId String

  fansite Fansite @relation(fields: [fansiteId], references: [id])
}

model FansiteProduct {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  period    String
  price     Float
  priceOld  Float?
  until     String?
  url       String
  fansiteId String

  fansite Fansite @relation(fields: [fansiteId], references: [id])
}

model Subscription {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  tier       String   @default("free")
  startDate  DateTime @default(now())
  endDate    DateTime?
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true)
  paymentMethod String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
}

model ChatRequest {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  senderId   String
  receiverId String
  status     String   @default("pending")
  message    String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  sender   User @relation("SentChatRequest", fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  receiver User @relation("ReceivedChatRequest", fields: [receiverId], references: [id])
}

model GroupChat {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  avatar      String?
  description String?
  ownerId     String
  isPublic    Boolean  @default(false)
  maxMembers  Int      @default(50)
  address     String?
  lat         Float?
  lng         Float?
  geoName     String?
  tags        String?
  hidden      Boolean  @default(false)
  eventStart  DateTime?
  eventEnd    DateTime?
  duration    Int?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  owner   User           @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  members GroupMember[]
  messages Message[]
}

model GroupMember {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  groupId   String
  role      String   @default("member")
  joinedAt  DateTime @default(now())

  user  User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  group GroupChat @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, groupId])
}

model Event {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  description  String?
  location    String?
  lat         Float?
  lng         Float?
  startDate   DateTime
  endDate     DateTime?
  imageUrl    String?
  type        String   @default("social")
  attendeeCount Int    @default(0)
  ownerId     String
  isPublic    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  owner  User         @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  rsvps  EventRSVP[]
}

model EventRSVP {
  id       String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId   String
  eventId  String
  status   String   @default("going")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user  User  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  event Event @relation(fields: [eventId], references: [id])

  @@unique([userId, eventId])
}

model Footprint {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  targetId  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user   User @relation("FootprintCreator", fields: [userId], references: [id])
  target User @relation("FootprintTarget", fields: [targetId], references: [id])

  @@unique([userId, targetId])
}

model Boost {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  type      String   @default("standard")
  duration  Int      @default(30)
  startedAt DateTime @default(now())
  endsAt    DateTime
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
}

model Shout {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  content   String
  type      String   @default("text")
  mediaUrl  String?
  userId    String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
}

model UserNote {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  content   String
  type      String   @default("private")
  writerId  String
  targetId  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  writer User @relation("NoteWriter", fields: [writerId], references: [id])
  target User @relation("NoteTarget", fields: [targetId], references: [id])

  @@unique([writerId, targetId])
}

model UserFavorite {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  targetId  String
  isSuper   Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user   User @relation("FavBy", fields: [userId], references: [id])
  target User @relation("SuperFavBy", fields: [targetId], references: [id])

  @@unique([userId, targetId])
}

model Blog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  title     String
  content   String
  imageUrl  String?
  slug      String   @unique
  userId    String
  isPublished Boolean @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
}

model Video {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  title     String
  url       String
  thumbnailUrl String?
  duration  Int?
  userId    String
  isPrivate Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
}

model Banner {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  title     String
  imageUrl  String
  linkUrl   String?
  position  Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  userId    String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
}

model Verification {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String   @unique
  type      String   @default("age")
  status    String   @default("none")
  documentUrl String?
  phone     String?
  phonePrefix String?
  submittedAt DateTime?
  reviewedAt  DateTime?
  notes     String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
}

model UserSession {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  device    String?
  platform  String?
  ip        String?
  token     String?
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  lastSeen  DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CIRCLES (from Grindr) — Custom profile groups/categories
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
model Circle {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  color     String   @default("#6366f1")
  icon      String   @default("circle")
  userId    String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user    User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  members CircleMember[]
}

model CircleMember {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  circleId     String
  targetUserId String
  userId       String
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  circle  Circle @relation(fields: [circleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user    User   @relation("CircleMembership", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@unique([circleId, targetUserId])
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CHECK-IN (from OMOLINK) — Location check-in with venue
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
model Checkin {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  venueName String
  lat       Float
  lng       Float
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// WALLET & TRANSACTIONS (from OMOLINK) — Virtual currency
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
model Wallet {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String   @unique
  balance   Float    @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user         User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  transactions Transaction[]
}

model Transaction {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  walletId    String
  type        String
  amount      Float
  description String
  referenceId String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  wallet Wallet @relation(fields: [walletId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SAVED PHRASES (from Grindr) — Quick reply templates
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
model SavedPhrase {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  title     String
  content   String
  sortOrder Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONVERSATION PARTICIPANT (from Grindr) — Mute, archive, pin
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
model ConversationParticipant {
  id         String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  otherUserId String
  isMuted    Boolean   @default(false)
  mutedUntil DateTime?
  isArchived Boolean   @default(false)
  isPinned   Boolean   @default(false)
  lastReadAt DateTime?
  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@unique([userId, otherUserId])
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// LIKED PHOTOS (from ROMEO) — Track individual photo likes
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
model LikedPhoto {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  photoId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@unique([userId, photoId])
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONTACT FOLDERS (from ROMEO) — Organize contacts
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
model ContactFolder {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  name      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user    User                    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  members ContactFolderMember[]
}

model ContactFolderMember {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  folderId     String
  targetUserId String
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  folder ContactFolder @relation(fields: [folderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@unique([folderId, targetUserId])
}

  "tsx": true,

{
  "name": "nextjs_tailwind_shadcn_ts",
  "version": "0.2.1",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "npx next dev --webpack -p 3000 2>&1 | tee dev.log",
    "build": "next build && cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/.next/ && cp -r public .next/standalone/",
    "start": "NODE_ENV=production bun .next/standalone/server.js 2>&1 | tee server.log",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "db:push": "prisma db push --accept-data-loss",
    "db:generate": "prisma generate",
    "db:migrate": "prisma migrate dev",
    "db:reset": "prisma migrate reset"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@dnd-kit/core": "^6.3.1",
    "@dnd-kit/sortable": "^10.0.0",
    "@dnd-kit/utilities": "^3.2.2",
    "@hookform/resolvers": "^5.1.1",
    "@mdxeditor/editor": "^3.39.1",
    "@prisma/client": "^6.11.1",
    "@radix-ui/react-accordion": "^1.2.11",
    "@radix-ui/react-alert-dialog": "^1.1.14",
    "@radix-ui/react-aspect-ratio": "^1.1.7",
    "@radix-ui/react-avatar": "^1.1.10",
    "@radix-ui/react-checkbox": "^1.3.2",
    "@radix-ui/react-collapsible": "^1.1.11",
    "@radix-ui/react-context-menu": "^2.2.15",
    "@radix-ui/react-dialog": "^1.1.14",
    "@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu": "^2.1.15",
    "@radix-ui/react-hover-card": "^1.1.14",
    "@radix-ui/react-label": "^2.1.7",
    "@radix-ui/react-menubar": "^1.1.15",
    "@radix-ui/react-navigation-menu": "^1.2.13",
    "@radix-ui/react-popover": "^1.1.14",
    "@radix-ui/react-progress": "^1.1.7",
    "@radix-ui/react-radio-group": "^1.3.7",
    "@radix-ui/react-scroll-area": "^1.2.9",
    "@radix-ui/react-select": "^2.2.5",
    "@radix-ui/react-separator": "^1.1.7",
    "@radix-ui/react-slider": "^1.3.5",
    "@radix-ui/react-slot": "^1.2.3",
    "@radix-ui/react-switch": "^1.2.5",
    "@radix-ui/react-tabs": "^1.1.12",
    "@radix-ui/react-toast": "^1.2.14",
    "@radix-ui/react-toggle": "^1.1.9",
    "@radix-ui/react-toggle-group": "^1.1.10",
    "@radix-ui/react-tooltip": "^1.2.7",
    "@reactuses/core": "^6.0.5",
    "@tanstack/react-query": "^5.82.0",
    "@tanstack/react-table": "^8.21.3",
